desc: Prove that repeatedly choosing the minimum-strength adjacent slime is sufficient and that stopping when it is ineligible means no adjacent slime is eligible.
Design the priority-queue expansion algorithm, including visited-state handling so each grid cell is inserted at most once.
Check strict inequality implementation carefully using integer arithmetic: `value * X < strength`.
Analyze time and memory complexity for up to `H*W = 250000` cells.
Implement stdin parsing, heap-based traversal from `(P-1, Q-1)`, stdout output, and verify all sample cases.
